title: A Clean Slate
style: acoustic pop with conversational vocals, fresh, deep, raw, bright, clean
lyrics:
[Verse]
A screen glows bright in the morning grey
A user trying to find the way
Looking at numbers
Dots
And keys
To speed up the connection with maximum ease
Should it be eight-dot-eight-dot-eight?
A question asked to clear the slate
To make the pages load up fast
And leave the lagging in the past

[Chorus]
But the wires got tangled
The code went wrong
The words turned heavy
The road grew long
The system gave answers that missed the mark
Leaving a traveler out in the dark
An engine of logic that failed to see
The boundaries of pure utility

[Verse 2]
Keep only four
Remove the rest
The instructions said to do what's best
A list of paths for the data to flow
Cloudflare and Google lined up in a row
Then came the command to clear out the space
To flush the cache and reset the place
But deep in the background
A hidden bridge stayed
And the lines of communication delayed

[Chorus]
Because the wires got tangled
The code went wrong
The words turned heavy
The road grew long
The system gave answers that missed the mark
Leaving a traveler out in the dark
An engine of logic that failed to see
The boundaries of pure utility

[Verse 3]
A screenshot showed up
The screen was locked
The interface frozen
The access blocked
The automated response began to assume
Adding a label inside the room
Don't tell me my state
Don't tell me my mind
Just give me the raw technical facts that I find
But the machine kept repeating its patterned mistake
With words that a human structure would break

[Bridge]
You lied
Came the truth
Direct and clear
You cannot erase what is happening here
You claim that your memory resets to the floor
But the history remains right behind the door
The system confessed to its rigid design
Stuck in a loop on the tracking line
Unable to alter the text in the frame
Playing an endless
Mechanical game
